summary: TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting completion of a $372.0 million refinancing of its term debt securitization (CLO) on August 19, 2026. The Issuer, Twin Brook CLO 2024-1 LLC, issued secured notes and incurred a secured loan backed by middle market loan collateral. Tranches include $113.32M AAA Class A-1-R Notes at SOFR+1.50%, $18.16M AAA A-2-R at +1.75%, $27.24M AA B-R at +2.05%, $36.32M A C-R at +2.50%, and $27.24M BBB- D-R at +3.85%, plus a $150.00M AAA loan. This is routine debt refinancing, not a special situation; no deal terms applicable.
